# Output files

When the report helper and write access are available, each skill writes a fixed filename family, so downstream skills (`report-pdf`, `counsel-handoff`, `search-precedent`) can find earlier results. Saved reports follow shared contract v1: each run gets its own folder under an approved output root, never beside the input documents or in the working directory's root, and an existing report is never overwritten.

```text
reviews/
└── <fund>/
    └── <date>/
        └── <run-id>/
            ├── run.json
            └── <subfolder>/
                └── <report-id>/
                    ├── <filename>
                    └── <filename>.json
```

Without the helper or required write access, the fallback is an **UNVERIFIED chat draft**, not a saved report. A completed report can be `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `PARTIAL` or `BLOCKED`; none is operational approval.

`run.json` records the run; each report sits in its own folder next to a `.json` evidence sidecar that lists its sources with their SHA-256 hashes. Folders are created private to your user (0700) and files 0600; permissions on existing folders and backups remain the operator's responsibility. Hashes identify content, not authenticity. The `<subfolder>` depends on the kind of report:

| Folder | Filename families |
|---|---|
| `reports/` | `LPA-REVIEW-…`, `PPM-REVIEW-…`, `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-…`, `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-…`, `CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-…`, `DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-…`, `CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-…`, `K1-REVIEW-…`, `POA-REVIEW-…`, `GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-…`, `DEED-REVIEW-…`, `COUNSEL-HANDOFF-…`, `TAX-REVIEW-…`, `INGEST-REPORT-…`, `EMAIL-INGEST-…`, `FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf` |
| `analysis/` | `BENCHMARK-REPORT-…`, `WATERFALL-REVIEW-…`, `TERMS-EXTRACT-…`, `PLAIN-ENGLISH-…`, `FUND-COMPARISON-…`, `MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-…`, `TERMS-PLAYBOOK-…`, `PRECEDENT-SEARCH-…`, `NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-…`, `ENTITY-MAP-…`, `RECONCILIATION-…` |
| `drafts/` | `CAPITAL-CALL-…`, `DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-…`, `INVESTOR-LETTER-…`, `SIDE-LETTER-…`, `AMENDMENT-DRAFT-…`, `BOARD-MEMO-…`, `DDQ-RESPONSE-…`, `DATA-ROOM-…`, `AUDIT-SUPPORT-…`, `ESG-REPORT-…` |
| `compliance/` | `COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-…`, `KYC-REVIEW-…`, `AML-SCREENING-…`, `FATCA-CRS-CLASSIFICATION-…`, `INVESTOR-CLASSIFICATION-…`, `SUITABILITY-CHECK-…`, `SUBSCRIPTION-PROCESS-…`, `ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-…`, `FILING-PREP-…`, `REGULATORY-CALENDAR-…`, `WIRE-VERIFY-…` |
| `tracking/` | `MFN-TRACKER-…`, `MFN-ELECTION-…`, `OBLIGATION-TRACKER-…`, `COVENANT-MONITOR-…`, `KYC-TRACKER-…`, `EMAIL-MONITOR-…`, `INGEST-MANIFEST-…` |
| `analytics/` | `PERFORMANCE-REPORT-…`, `CASHFLOW-FORECAST-…`, `SCENARIO-MODEL-…`, `FEE-AUDIT-…`, `WATERFALL-SIM-…` |
| `portfolio/` | `PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-…` |

`report-pdf` writes `FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf` into the same run. A skill called by another shares its parent's run ID and writes under its own report ID. Every command's page in this manual names its file, and [`catalog.json`](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/catalog.json) lists them for machines.

Placeholders in filenames are always `[fund]`, `[investor]`, `[type]` and `[date]`; `[fund]` is a slug of the fund name and `[date]` is the review date. Skills create runs and write reports with the packaged helper, `fund_report.py new-run` and `write-report`.
